entry.title: Munttoren
entry.note: Center is refined from the concentric tower parts instead of the bounding box containing asymmetric projections. Both southeast and northwest projections are reproduced from their exact map polygons; the octagonal clock stages retain their mapped directed axes. The adjoining former guard house is a separately mapped building; it is not included or used to scale the tower. Small stone ornament and restored openings follow current photographs. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
